title: SimplePunishments
description: Simple punishment plugin for medium sized servers!
body:
### Commands ✅
- ✅ `/ban <player> <reason>` - Permanent ban
- ✅ `/tempban <player> <duration> <reason>` - Temp ban (7d, 1h, etc)
- ✅ `/banip <player|ip> <reason>` - Ban IP address
- ✅ `/tempbanip <player|ip> <duration> <reason>` - Temp IP ban
- ✅ `/kick <player> <reason>` - Instant kick
- ✅ `/warn <player> <reason>` - Issue warning
- ✅ `/mute <player> <reason>` - Permanent mute
- ✅ `/tempmute <player> <duration> <reason>` - Temp mute
- ✅ `/muteip <player|ip> <reason>` - IP mute
- ✅ `/hist <player>` - Punishment history

**Permissions:**
```
simplepunish.ban       = Ban players
simplepunish.kick      = Kick players
simplepunish.mute      = Mute players
simplepunish.hist      = View history
simplepunish.*         = All permissions
```

**Duration Formats:**
```
10m = 10 minutes
1h  = 1 hour
1d  = 1 day
7d  = 7 days
30d = 30 days
```

Dm mrdonutern on discord for help!
